title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E6 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Michael, Ricardo, Miguel
Ricky has spent a total of 266 days in Lake County, and another 16 months at a residential placement facility in Nevada; when he didn't return to his placement in Nevada after a weekend home pass, Ricky was picked up on a bench warrant.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Tipped Off
At Indiana State Prison, visitation is a valued privilege for inmates, but it can also be abused; it's the most common route for contraband to enter the prison; an anonymous tip has put Internal Affairs on high alert.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Cutting
From the most trusted inmates, working at the prison barbershop, to inmate assaults on prison staff, or inmates who turn violence against themselves, at Indiana State Prison, "cutting" has many meanings.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Predator & Prey
In a world dictated by fear, some resort to violence, and others become victims, while those on death row at Indiana State Prison can only wait for the inevitable.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Purple Pain
Deputies respond to a possible gang beating, but the surveillance cameras don't catch anything; a wounded warrior faces a new battle when he and his girlfriend both get arrested.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Fatality
A fight breaks out over snacks, but officers want to know if there was something else behind it; an open transgender inmate, who "escorts" on the street, chooses general population over protective custody; an inmate is found dead in his bunk.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Lightning Voltz
The Louisville Metro Department of Corrections Jail has a daily population of about 2,000 men and women charged with anything from minor crimes to capital murder; both buildings are overcrowded, and their layouts are outdated.

title: Lockup: San Quentin: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Slammin' in the Slammer
At San Quentin, every inmate is marked with a security level based on his crime and prison behavior; serving as a reception center, the overpopulated prison must house a dangerous mix of levels within proximity of one another.

title: Lockup: San Antonio: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Sick
An inmate with an influential family in one gang, joins its arch rival; a female inmate who has ties to both gangs finds her mail has jail officials concerned.
